technical-summary: The Flash-Next launcher gains --num-spec N (MTP speculative depth, 0 = off); the depth was fixed at 3 and only a layout's server-args could change it. Another depth is another plan key, so it starts without the live policy and the launcher's live placement line says so.
user-summary-candidate: The lab launcher can now start the model with a different speculative-decoding depth, so depths can be compared.
